name: ring-mcp-server
description: Comprehensive Ring Security System Management for Claude Desktop
long_description: Ring MCP Server provides complete integration with Ring security devices including cameras, doorbells, security systems, and fire safety devices. Features real-time device monitoring, live streaming, alarm control, and comprehensive system management using FastMCP 2.12.0.

ring_token.title: Ring API Token
ring_token.description: Ring API token (optional - will be generated from username/password)

enable_monitoring.title: Enable Monitoring
enable_monitoring.description: Enable Prometheus metrics and monitoring features

tools.name: get_devices
tools.description: Get a list of all Ring devices

tools.name: get_device_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific device

tools.name: get_device_events
tools.description: Get recent events for a specific device

tools.name: get_live_stream_url
tools.description: Get a live stream URL for a camera device

tools.name: set_arm_status
tools.description: Arm or disarm a security device

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health of the Ring MCP service

tools.name: list_connected_servers
tools.description: List all connected MCP servers and their namespaces

tools.name: disconnect_server
tools.description: Disconnect from a connected MCP server

tools.name: call_namespaced_tool
tools.description: Call a tool from a connected MCP server using namespace prefix

prompts.name: analyze_security_system
prompts.description: Analyze Ring security system status and provide recommendations
prompts.text: Analyze the Ring security system with {{analysis_type}} analysis at {{detail_level}} level. Provide comprehensive insights about device health, security status, and recommendations for optimal performance.

prompts.name: troubleshoot_device
prompts.text: Troubleshoot the {{device_type}} device with the following issue: {{problem_description}}. Provide step-by-step diagnosis and resolution steps.
